title: DeepAffinity: Long-Term Aspect Preference Prediction in eCommerce using Small Language Models
title_zh: DeepAffinity：利用小型语言模型预测电商用户的长期方面偏好
abstract_en: We explore predicting eCommerce user preferences for product aspects such as brand, size, and color - a task we define as Aspect Affinity. Solving this task improves customer understanding and enables fine-grained personalization in recommendation, search, and marketing. We frame Aspect Affinity as a temporal prediction task: forecasting a users future aspect choices from their time-ordered interaction history, capturing long-term preferences that evolve beyond the current session. To this end, we propose DeepAffinity, which leverages Small Language Models (SLMs) with structured prompts and specialized prediction heads fine-tuned for this task. We show DeepAffinity outperforms standard generative fine-tuning methods, while general-purpose open-source LLMs perform poorly without task-specific tuning, highlighting their limits in modeling nuanced behavior. Finally, DeepAffinity enhances recommendation quality on a large-scale multinational eCommerce platform.
abstract_zh: 本文研究电商用户对商品具体方面（如品牌、尺码和颜色）的偏好预测问题，并将其定义为方面偏好（Aspect Affinity）。该任务能够加深对用户的理解，并支持推荐、搜索和营销中的细粒度个性化。作者将方面偏好建模为时间序列预测任务：基于用户按时间排序的交互历史，预测其未来在不同商品方面上的选择，从而捕捉超越当前会话、持续演化的长期偏好。为此，提出DeepAffinity，采用带结构化提示（structured prompts）的小型语言模型（Small Language Models, SLMs），并结合针对该任务微调的专用预测头。在大规模跨国电商平台上的实验表明，DeepAffinity优于标准生成式微调方法；通用开源大语言模型若缺乏任务特定调优，表现较差，说明其在建模细粒度用户行为方面存在局限。最终，DeepAffinity能够提升推荐质量。
key_points_zh: 将品牌、尺码、颜色等商品属性偏好定义为Aspect Affinity，并建模为基于历史交互的时间序列预测任务。
提出DeepAffinity，结合结构化提示与专用预测头，针对长期、持续演化的用户偏好进行任务特定建模。
DeepAffinity优于标准生成式微调方法，表明专门的预测架构对该任务十分关键。
通用开源LLM在未经任务特定调优时表现不佳，难以捕捉细粒度电商行为模式。
在大规模跨国电商平台上，DeepAffinity进一步提升了推荐质量。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant industrial e-commerce study that models evolving product-aspect preferences and demonstrates gains in recommendation quality.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作面向真实电商场景建模持续演化的商品属性偏好，并展示了对推荐质量的实际提升。
